public_rationale: The prediction has no deadline. ARC Prize documents substantial progress but explicitly says its result does not establish AGI. That does not meet the early-resolution rule. Failure to establish AGI by October 28 cannot support a prediction that generative AI will never produce it.
limitations: A single benchmark cannot establish or exclude broad general capability.
The search does not establish universal absence of qualifying systems.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI will not lead to AGI.

statement.excerpt: Generative AI will not bring us AGI, nor does it do much of what we associate with artificial intelligence.

from_speaker: Generative AI will not bring us AGI
our_interpretation: The normalized proposition concerns the forecast about AGI; the accompanying phrase about what people associate with intelligence supplies no separate measurable threshold.
I use the ordinary reading of AGI as broadly general human-level intellectual capability, including learning unfamiliar tasks.
Bring us includes a system substantially based on generative AI that also uses tools, memory, or other supporting components.
A vendor announcement or success on one benchmark is insufficient; the capability must be independently demonstrated across domains.
criteria.support_condition: A valid general impossibility result covering the agreed scope could support the categorical prediction. Continued nonachievement over any finite observation period cannot establish that generative AI will never lead to AGI.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A generative-AI-based system independently demonstrates broadly general human-level intellectual capabilities and the result receives broad credible validation.

evidence.explanation: ARC Prize reports major gains, including 99.9% with a provider-adapted harness, but expressly rejects treating benchmark saturation as proof of AGI. This is relevant progress against the prediction, without meeting the decisive-event rule.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: An independently validated, broadly general human-level system substantially based on generative AI would contradict the prediction under the stated rule.
